key_impacts: Severe social, economic and psychological impacts reported
evidence_snippets: 17 January 1995, 5:46: a magnitude 7.9 earthquake shook Kobe and adjoining areas in Hyogo Prefecture, Japan.
Destroyed thousands of houses and left millions of people homeless.
Damages to buildings in Niigata were high.
